question.text: Two cars are approaching each other at an equal speed of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>7</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi>km</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi>hr</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math> When they see each other, both blow horns having a frequency of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>676</mn><mo> </mo><mi>Hz</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The beat frequency heard by each driver will be _______<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Hz</mi><mo>.</mo></math> [Velocity of sound in air is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>340</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>.</mo></math>

solution.text:
Frequency of sound heard by car-1, which comes by reflection from car-2

f1=f0340+2340-2340+2340-2

=f03423382

Frequency of sound coming directly from car-2

f2=f0340+2340-2

∴  f1-f2=f0342338342338-1=8.09≃8 Hz
